svg.title: How I build large-document pipelines
svg.desc: Large-document pipeline as an isometric factory floor: an ingest path with a cache-hit bypass builds a knowledge graph and vector layer; an answer path searches, re-ranks, extracts with the LLM, validates, passes a human gate and writes cited output to an audit trail; an eval loop tunes retrieval and the model. Extraction accuracy ~70% to ~90%.
